title: Referendum-day anti-war protest gatherings (post-month lead)
location: Several locations in Belarus including Minsk; source does not provide an exhaustive location list.

start_date.summary: RFE/RL published on February 27 and states protests broke out that day.

location.summary: RFE/RL reports several locations and protests in Minsk and other cities.

demands.summary: RFE/RL attributes anti-war and anti-government demands to the gatherings.

participants.summary: No reliable attendance estimate; the reported 300-plus detentions are not a total attendance count.

notes: This is a separate event lead after the assigned month, not a continuation from a January onset. Follow up in belarus_2022-02. Do not create a January event or infer attendee threshold from detention totals.
